subject: Private deployment geo-boundary, audit roster & escrow options
messages:
From: Sarah Martin <sarah.martin@medsyshealth.com>
To: david.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@medsyshealth.com
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: Private deployment: geo boundary and audit/escrow asks

David —

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal and our infrastructure team have three immediate asks before we can sign the Order Form for the private VPC deployment:

1) Geo-boundary: we need confirmation on whether the deployed instance can be restricted to a single AWS region (us-east-1) and whether we can get a contractual commitment that backups/snapshots will not leave that region.

2) Audit roster & witness: our security team wants a template operator roster and a proposed onboarding/witnessing window for an operator-run snapshot exercise. Who would be the point contact on Redwood's side for the operator witness?

3) Escrow-like assurance: because we are a regulated healthcare provider, our counsel prefers a short form "escrow-lite" or custodian arrangement that documents evidence access (runbooks, signed snapshots, and verification steps) in case of termination. Attach: MedSys_Audit_Scope.pdf (high-level).

Can you route this to your legal/ops folks and provide proposed redlines (or a shortlist of options) by EOD Tuesday? We need to keep the timeline tight for Q4 onboarding.

Thanks —
Sarah Martin
Sr. Counsel, MedSys Health
--
MedSys Health | security@medsyshealth.com
Attachment: MedSys_Audit_Scope.pdf

From: david.kim@redwoodinference.com
To: Sarah Martin <sarah.martin@medsyshealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:24:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: geo boundary and audit/escrow asks

Sarah —

Appreciate the clarity. Looping in Laura (legal) and Connor (ops) to propose options and draft short redlines. Quick summary of how we see it and the options we can offer:

• Geo-boundary: Redwood can guarantee primary residency in a pinned region (us-east-1) for runtime and snapshots. We can add an Exhibit to the MSA and an Order Form clause to restrict cross-region replication. We need to preserve the ability to restore to a different region for disaster recovery — we can limit that to an explicit, documented DR event with prior notice to you.

• Audit roster & witness: Connor will propose a standard Audit Roster Template (roles, e-mail addresses, NDA/visitor requirements) and a 2‑hour operator witness window for a forensic snapshot verification. We typically run those during US business hours; on-site witnessing is possible for an additional ops fee or can be done remotely with recorded verification steps.

• Escrow-lite: we can offer three approaches: (A) contractual exhibit describing staged evidence handback (runbooks + signed snapshots + playbook); (B) third-party custodian (neutral escrow agent) holding sealed snapshots and access credentials under an agreed trigger; (C) a hybrid: Redwood holds encrypted sealed snapshots and a notarized hash is deposited with a third party — custodian only releases under termination + verification. Laura, I flagged the MSA for a short exhibit and attached a starting draft of our redlines (MSA_Redlines_DK_v1.docx).

Action items:
1) Laura — review and propose binding language for the geo-boundary exhibit and escrow-lite options.
2) Connor — draft Audit_Roster_Template.xlsx and a short ops runbook for the witness exercise (include typical SLA/fee for on-site).
3) David (me) — once we have legal + ops input, circulate a single redline bundle back to Sarah and procurement.

Sarah — can you confirm whether on-site witnessing is required or remote recorded verification will suffice? That will determine lead times.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: MSA_Redlines_DK_v1.docx

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: david.kim@redwoodinference.com, Sarah Martin <sarah.martin@medsyshealth.com>
Cc: connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: geo boundary and audit/escrow asks

David / Sarah —

Quick read and proposed language fragments below. I kept the text concise so procurement can copy into their redline set. Happy to expand.

1) Region residency clause (suggested Exhibit X to MSA):
"Redwood shall host Customer's dedicated Private Deployment and associated backup artifacts within the AWS us-east-1 region. Except as required for an approved disaster recovery event ("DR Event"), Redwood shall not transfer Customer backup artifacts outside of us-east-1 without Customer's prior written consent. A DR Event will be documented, and Customer will be notified no less than 48 hours prior to any cross-region transfer unless imminent loss of service requires immediate action."

2) Audit roster & witness (Order Form Exhibit Y):
- Redwood will provide an Audit Roster Template specifying operator roles, contact e-mails, and evidence of screening (background check / NDAs).
- Redwood will provide one remote witness session (up to 2 hours) at no additional charge within the onboarding window. On-site witnessing or additional sessions incur a pass-through charge as detailed in Schedule Z.

3) Escrow-lite options (Order Form Exhibit Z — pick one):
A) Documentation-only: Redwood will ship a sealed evidence binder (signed runbook, procedure logs, and snapshot hash) at termination.
B) Third-party custodian: Redwood will deposit a sealed, encrypted snapshot hash with an agreed third-party custodian; custodian release conditions described in Exhibit Z.
C) Hybrid: Redwood retains encrypted sealed snapshots; a notarized hash is deposited with custodian. Release triggers: (i) Customer termination for cause where Redwood fails to cure within 60 days; (ii) insolvency events; (iii) mutual written agreement.

We should also add a short verification acceptance test (VAT) step in the onboarding Order Form so Customer can validate the snapshot hash against a live verification within the first 30 days.

Timeline: if we get confirmation that remote witness is acceptable, Connor can provide the roster and runbook by EOD Monday; Laura can produce redlines by EOD Tuesday.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
--
